name: Kings of the Realm
storyline: An ancient evil devoured their homeland and forced the Trinity to set sail in search of a second chance at life. In their vast numbers, they have settled in Vinland, a place of hope. Now, in their desperate struggle for survival against all odds, they find not only new dangers beyond their camps but within their own numbers as well. The Trinity are divided as they scramble for control of their new home, wage war amongst themselves and confront uncertainty in the face of impending annihilation…
